youtube_description:
Novak Djokovic has withdrawn from the BNP Paribas Open at Indian Wells  for 2023 after failing to receive an exemption to his unvaccinated status meaning for a second year in a row Nole will miss the event. There is no word if he can play at the Miami Open yet.
